result:
The analysis confirms that Solution 1 arrives at the correct asymptotic result for the limiting probability distribution $\kappa[m]$ of the number of leaves at maximum depth in random plane binary trees.

Solution 1: $\kappa[m]\sim\frac{2^{1-m}}{m}$
Solution 2: $\kappa[m]\sim\frac{4}{m\,4^m}$
Solution 3: $\kappa[m]\sim 2\cdot 4^{-m}$

Solution 1 provides the correct leading asymptotic equivalent.

CHOICE: 1
